Revision

Choose the correct option.

1. When my dad was young, he ___ climb trees very well.

2. We ___ take the lift because the stairs were closed.

3. You ___ be careful when you look down from a great height.

4. We ___ pay to enter the park because it was free.

Ex. 1 Discuss the situation.

Imagine it’s your mum or dad’s birthday but you don’t know what present to buy. Who would you ask for advice? What would you say?

Ex. 2 Where do you think Adam is going?

Ex. 3 Read the dialogue and answer the questions.

Adam: I need your advice, Josh. I’ve got a Saturday job and tomorrow’s my first day. What should I wear?

Josh: I think you should look smart on your first day. What about wearing a white shirt and black trousers?

Adam: OK, wait a minute.

Adam: What do you think?

Josh: Hmm, not bad, but in my opinion, you shouldn’t wear trainers. They don’t look very smart. And why don’t you put on a tie?

Adam: What about this?

Josh: Oh, yes, that’s much better. By the way, what’s the job?

Adam: Well, it’s not a job really. I’m a volunteer. At the animal rescue centre in town.

Josh: Animal rescue centre? What do you have to do?

Adam: I have to clean the cages and feed the dogs!

Josh: In a white shirt and a tie?

Questions: 1. What advice does Adam need? –

2. What’s Josh’s advice? –

Ex. 4 Study the new phrases.

Match the phrase with the definition.

I need your advice. / Can I ask your advice?

What should I wear?

You should look smart.

You shouldn’t wear trainers.

In my opinion, you shouldn’t wear trainers.

What about wearing a white shirt?

Why don’t you put on a tie?

Ex. 5 Put the dialogue in the correct order.

Anna: You shouldn’t go to bed so late.

Kate: But I’ve already set three alarms on my phone!

Kate: You’re right. I should go to bed earlier.

Anna: You should set another one then!

Anna: And why don’t you set an alarm on your phone?

Kate: I need your advice, Anna. I was late again for school this morning. What should I do?

Do the same but on your own:

Then why don’t you put on this floral top? It’s very pretty.

Hi, What kind of party is it?

Hi, Sally. Can I ask your advice? I’m going to a party on Saturday. What should I wear?

Well, what about wearing these black jeans? And this pink shirt is very stylish.

Thanks, that’s a good idea.

Yes, it is, but it isn’t my shirt. It’s mum’s and I have to give it back to her.

It’s my granny’s birthday and I have to look smart.

Ex. 7 Complete the dialogue with the words in the box. There are two extra words.

Vocabulary box: about how in need should should shouldn’t why

Josh: Hey, Adam. I ¹______ your advice. I want to buy mum a birthday present, but I don’t know what to buy.

Adam: ²______ my opinion, you ³______ buy her a detective story. Your mum likes books and mysteries.

Josh: No, she’s got a lot of books.

Adam: What ⁴______ giving her some flowers? And you can make her a cake.

Josh: Good idea. What kind of cake ⁵______ I make?

Adam: ⁶______ don’t you make a chocolate cake? Everyone likes chocolate!

Josh: That’s a great idea – thanks!
